Let r(m) = {r +km | k ∈ Z} for integers 0 ⩽ r < m. For r1 (m1 )∩r2 (m2 ) = ∅
define the class transposition τr1 (m1 ),r2 (m2 ) as the involution which interchanges
r1 + km1 and r2 + km2 for each integer k and fixes everything else. The group
CT(Z) generated by all class transpositions is simple (Math. Z., 264, no. 4 (2010),
927–938). Is Out(CT(Z)) = ⟨σ 7→ σ n7→−n−1 ⟩ ∼    = C2 ?                         S. Kohl
